levels.name: Banegårdshallen (the station hall, street level); DSB also calls it "Ventesal/forhal" / "Forhal"
levels.note: Street level: hall with ticket office, shops, toilets; entrances from Banegårdspladsen, Bernstorffsgade and Reventlowsgade. Tietgensbroen (the Tietgensgade road bridge crossing the platforms further south) is also at street level. During 2026–28 DSB splits the hall into "en tydelig rejsehal og en butikshal".
levels._source: DSB station page København H, https://www.dsb.dk/trafikinformation/stationer/kobenhavn-h/, read 2026-10-30; DSB, "En moderniseret Københavns Hovedbanegård" (modernisation page), https://www.dsb.dk/om-dsb/baredygtighed/virksomheden/modernisering-af-kbh-h/, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia, "Copenhagen Central Station", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen_Central_Station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_dk, ODbL), read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Platforms (perron 1–6, spor 1–12) in the cutting below the hall; perron 7 (spor 26) further south
levels.note: No signposted name for the platform level found. Track 26 (perron 7): Wikipedia says it is about 200 m south of the main building and 'reachable only by walking along the platform for track 4 and 5'. S-tog use spor 9–12 (Wikipedia).
levels._source: Wikipedia, "Copenhagen Central Station", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen_Central_Station, read 2026-10-30; Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027 Bilag 3.6 + Banedanmark Open Data (platform register /home/claude/dk/out/dk_register), read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_dk, ODbL), read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Pedestrian tunnel under the tracks to the Metro (København H, M3/M4)
levels.note: Wikipedia: 'A pedestrian tunnel connects the train station with the metro station (M3 and M4 lines)… The underground metro station can be accessed 24/7 directly from the platforms by an underpass under the tracks.' No signposted name found. Metro platforms out of scope.
levels._source: Wikipedia, "Copenhagen Central Station", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen_Central_Station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_dk, ODbL), read 2026-10-30

open: No DSB or Banedanmark station plan (PDF) for København H found; DSB's modernisation page has only illustrations. All shop/lift/stair positions are from OSM.

Which hall shops are behind the fences: DSB names only the shops that stay open (DSB Billetsalg, 7-Eleven, Lagkagehuset, Joe & The Juice, McDonald's, Max Burger, Starbucks, Dunkin' Donuts) and says three of four hall shop areas are fenced off April 2026 – mid-2028 (the 7-Eleven area until H2 2028). Status not stated for Hovedbanens Apotek, Dlet, Flowers, Forex, Dan Exchange, ATMs; OSM also has a vacant shop (n3887005211). Which of the four shop areas is where is not described in text.

Shop hours are OSM's opening_hours except DSB units: Lagkagehuset, Starbucks, Joe & The Juice and the pharmacy sites are client-side rendered and could not be read; mcdonalds.dk blocks fetching. Hours not confirmed by the shops' own sites.

DSB 7-Eleven hours (Mo-Fr 05-01, Sa-Su 24h) conflict with 7-Eleven's own list ('Press', KBH Banegårdspladsen: Mo-Fr 05:00-23:59, Sa-Su 24h); which physical unit DSB means is not stated. 7-Eleven's list (24+52 entries read) shows no other København H unit; platform kiosks rely on OSM.
Toilet fee amount and hours, ticket-machine positions, locker position, DSB 1' Lounge position and hours: not given by DSB.

Track 26 / perron 7 access: only Wikipedia's text; no geometry in the platform register. The DSB 2006–07 news mentions a lift at Tietgensbroen at the opposite end of perron 2; OSM has no lift at Tietgensbroen today — current status unknown.
Level names as signposted (beyond 'Forhal'/'Banegårdshallen') and level heights: no source.
No open-question list was supplied for Danish stations, so no 'answers' section.
